about: The Workbench icons of the OpenSupaplex drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The badge is the game's own icon art (amiga/icon/opensupaplex.png); the game's tool icon stays amiga/icon/opensupaplex.info (installed as OpenSupaplex.info). OpenSupaplex-drawer.info goes beside the drawer as OpenSupaplex.info.
